# RCA Copilot evaluation

**All numbers come from synthetic scenarios generated by `scripts/scenarios/`. They are not production incidents.**

- Date: 2026-10-26
- Model: qwen2.5:7b
- Hardware: Windows-10-10.0.26200-SP0; 22 logical CPUs; Intel(R) Core(TM) Ultra 7 155H, 15.4 GB RAM; GPU: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU, 8188 MiB. Elasticsearch 8.13.2 and MongoDB 7 run in Docker on the same machine.
- Command: `python scripts/evaluate.py --label after iterating on failure cases from the first run (context+focus fetch, change-proximity fields, ranker timeout/retry; baseline ranker prompt)`
- Code evaluated: after iterating on failure cases from the first run (context+focus fetch, change-proximity fields, ranker timeout/retry; baseline ranker prompt)
- Scenarios: 8 (0 hard), 5 runs each, 100,000 background log events per scenario
- Sources: Elasticsearch (logs), MongoDB (change events and metrics), real instances; Ollama LLM

## Parallel vs sequential collection (real connectors)

| Mode | Median sequential | Median parallel | Median speedup | Samples |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| io_only | 140ms | 94ms | 1.28x | 8 |
| with_llm_planner | 7172ms | 4858ms | 1.37x | 8 |

Each sample is one scenario's median (io_only: median of several timed runs; with_llm_planner: one timed run per mode). 'io_only' disables the LLM planner to isolate connector I/O. 'with_llm_planner' includes three query-planning LLM calls against one local Ollama instance, so its parallel gain depends on that instance's concurrency.

## Notes

- Scenarios are synthetic and were authored together with the system; ground-truth keywords were fixed before the first run and not changed afterwards.
- A run counts as correct only if a hypothesis contains every ground-truth keyword (substring, case-insensitive; '|' = alternatives) AND cites at least one evidence id from an expected source. This checks wording and citation, not the quality of the reasoning. The lenient figures (at most one keyword missing, same source rule) were defined before the full run and are secondary; strict accuracy is the headline number.
- All 5 runs of a scenario analyse identical data (fixed seed); the only variation between runs is LLM sampling (temperature 0.1).
- Metrics are stored in MongoDB with the Hive row shape; no Hive cluster was available, so the Hive connector is not exercised by this evaluation.
- The Elasticsearch connector excludes info/debug/trace logs server-side, so 'records collected' counts only warn/error-level logs plus change and metric rows; 'events in store' counts everything seeded. Row cap per source: 10,000.
- Compression = records collected per record cited by any hypothesis; it measures how far the pipeline narrows the data, not correctness.
- The LLM query planner fell back to the default query in at least one run for: bad_deploy_pool, config_timeout, dependency_outage, dropped_index.
